description: Angular/Ionic login page component for user authentication, including email/password and Facebook login, GPS check, and navigation.

classes.name: LoginPage
classes.description: Angular component for login functionality, handling user login via email/password and Facebook, GPS check, and navigation.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the login page, sets up form validation, and disables menu swipe.

methods.name: ionViewDidLoad
methods.description: Lifecycle hook called when the view is loaded; triggers GPS check.

methods.name: checkForGPS
methods.description: Checks if GPS is enabled using NativeMapContainerProvider.

methods.name: loginUser
methods.description: Handles user login with email and password, manages loading indicator, and navigates based on user profile.

methods.name: loginViaFacebook
methods.description: Handles Facebook login, manages loading indicator, and navigates based on user profile.

methods.name: goToResetPassword
methods.description: Navigates to the reset password page.
